title: Render Network: Miami After Dark
deadline: 2026-10-30 or 2026-11-15 (form open as of 2026-10-27; apply ASAP)
location: The National Hotel, Miami Beach, FL (50-foot outdoor projection)
fee: None (application free; rendering credits provided to selected artists)
fee_reason: N/A — fully free application and production support
what_they_look_for: Original digital work fitting ‘Miami After Dark’ theme, max 2 minutes, must be rendered on Render Network
receipts_required: Portfolio website or Google Drive link with previous work examples
Name, email, artist name, short ‘why this showcase’ statement
google_search: Render Network Miami After Dark open call
notes: Web3/crypto-related via decentralized GPU network. Conflicting deadline listings in secondary sources; primary form is live. Some sources list U.S. artists only — verify on form. 10-15 artists selected.

title: .ART Award 2026
type: award / prize with Miami announcement + optional Miami screen exhibition
event_dates: Winners announced December 3, 2026 at Art Basel Miami Beach; optional BitBasel Miami screens
location: Announcement during Miami Art Week / Art Basel Miami Beach; digital presence
fee: No submission fee. Requires a .ART domain (first-year registration often $2–10; renewals higher).
fee_reason: Submission is free. The domain is a permanent digital home for the practice and is required as the application vehicle. Justified by prestige (Jerry Saltz jury), $50k+ prizes including $15k cash, residencies, and public announcement during Art Basel Miami.
what_they_look_for: Documentation of creative process and story behind the work as much as the artwork itself
exhibition: Announcement and optional screen exhibition during Miami Art Week; prizes include future exhibitions
entry_included: Announcement event visibility; selected may appear on Miami screens if opted in
receipts_required: .ART domain URL pointing to content that includes: biography ≥100 words
High-quality images/video/3D of work with technical details
Written narrative ≥100 words OR 30s–1min video of artist discussing process
notes: Global, all disciplines, free entry. Strong digital/web3 relevance (Tezos prize, domains, platforms like OpenSea/Hug). Encouraging for artists building online presence.
